overall_goal: Prepare and chop the onion, chili pepper, and red bell pepper, then set them aside.

goals.rationale: The person retrieves the vegetables and a knife, peels the onion, cuts off the ends, slices it into pieces, and moves it to the side of the cutting board.
The person weighs the chili pepper, slices it into smaller pieces, cleans up the scraps, and slides the chopped chili aside.

goals.description: Deseed and slice the red bell pepper
goals.rationale: The person grabs the red bell pepper, removes its seeds and unwanted parts, slices it into thin strips, and moves the pieces to the cutting board.
